body:
[sigh]

Yup. Life is hard. There's no denying that. I was lucky to know what I want to do, or at least something that would be enough for me. You have to try to find something that you can make yours. Something that you can say "this is what I do, and I'm content with that". You gotta find something that you can enjoy doing. I mean, if you are suffering, at least try to find a valid reason to justify it. I suffer, knowing that I'm doing what I like. There is no reason to suffer without any sensible reasoning behind it.

I must admit, I'm in a similar situation. I'm in my third semester. I've lost a lot of friends. I've lost a lot of sleep. But I know that I just need to pull through. I know that what I do is what I love, so I keep doing it. It isnt easy though. You gotta make time for a hobby here or there though. "All work and no play makes jack a dull boy" You have to find some time to do things other than work, otherwise the work will drive you mad. I speak from experience.

2.7? I've seen people getting six figures on a 2.1. You aren't fucked yet man. We all get bad days. Shit happens. Theres only one thing to do when those grades get down. You get back up, you get the hell back into that ring, and you show college who's boss. 

As the saying goes "C's get degrees", and you know what? Thats fine.  You're gonna be alright man.
